headline: Dejan Kulusevski explains why he is 'different' after Tottenham injury hell
description: Dejan Kulusevski has said that he is "smarter" after ending a 526-day injury-enforced absence as Tottenham beat Coventry on Monday.

headline: A global experiment: Can ESPN predict the Ballon d'Or awards?
description: The Ballon d'Or awards are typically tough to predict, but can ESPN and our global resources do just that?

headline: Man City cheated because Premier League was built to be unfair
description: The Premier League is unfair: Some teams are allowed to spend more than everyone else. So, of course Man City cheated to win.

headline: Transfer rumors, news: Premier League clubs eye Alexander-Arnold amid Real Madrid uncertainty
description: Real Madrid defender Trent Alexander-Arnold is considering his future at the Bernabéu, with Liverpool, Chelsea, Arsenal and Man City monitoring his situation. Transfer Talk has the latest.

headline: Ayyoub Bouaddi, Carlos Baleba offer hope amidst gathering storms at Manchester United and Manchester City
description: It's been a bruising start to the season for the two Manchester giants, as Manchester United's struggles to rediscover their form under Michael Carrick show little sign of abating, and Manchester City contend with the consequences of their guilty verdict.

headline: Maddison scores in 'dream' return as Spurs get 1st PL win of season
description: An emotional James Maddison said it was like a "dream" to produce a goal and help Tottenham climb off the bottom of the Premier League with a 3-1 home win.
